description: Start AI video generation from a prompt. Use listModels with kind=video to check models, supported lengths, and video credit costs. Confirm the model and cost with the user first. The finished video is saved as a draft and is not published. Check progress with getVideoStatus.

duration.description: Seconds. Default 8. Must be a length the model supports (see `durations` in listModels).

model.description: A model id from GET /v1/models?kind=video (cost shown there; default google/veo-3.1-fast). The old names veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview and veo-3.1-generate-preview still work and run on google/veo-3.1-fast and google/veo-3.1.

prompt.description: Description of the video content to generate

name: generateVideo
